title: Oak at the archive, bronze at the hotel
body: The County Government Archive has paneled oak double doors, with rows of recessed panels on each leaf. Quartz Hotel picks up the geometric pattern of its entrance in bronze. At Orbit Clinic a stripe runs across the sliding glass leaves, and Mergeforge Office has a pair of framed glass doors.
